lxc_099068d747993306.text: When a company sells shares on a stock exchange, anyone can buy them.

lxc_6e73bba104121613.text: If the company has one million shares and you buy one thousand, you own 0.

lxc_fcda5e38112f490a.text: Toyota, for example, has hundreds of millions of shares traded on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

lxc_58063c85a3de7665.text: Owning Toyota shares means you own a tiny fraction of its factories, vehicles, and future earnings.

lxc_a0b04378b7f86764.text: Microsoft has done the same on the Nasdaq exchange in the USA, giving millions of people a stake in its software and cloud services.

lxc_bb0199b93c94d140.text: Stock investing fundamentals start with business revenue and profit.

lxc_259d7910039ff55f.text: Revenue is the total money a company receives from selling products or services.

lxc_369c2be2596d6626.text: Profit is what remains after paying all costs.

lxc_a51e414e3ee77095.text: A company can have high revenue but low profit when its costs are also high.

lxc_de55176b64f8e00b.text: 8 billion in net income for the year ended June 30, 2025.

lxc_0482ede28590b418.text: ASML, a Dutch maker of chip-making machines, reported €32.

lxc_2a9d9ed6e0bd0b42.text: These numbers describe business performance, but they do not show whether a share price is low or high.

lxc_03eca7293333d489.text: Valuation is the market's judgment of what a company is worth.

lxc_c3a764596d217e0c.text: Investors compare price with measures such as profit, but future results are uncertain.

lxc_bedd179632fc2c8a.text: Companies often borrow money to expand.

lxc_473a6bc30b6650ef.text: Debt is not always bad because it can fund useful growth.

lxc_872fbb6007a70c3f.text: However, a company must make interest payments and later repay the debt.

lxc_d158373c315d057e.text: Those payments reduce the money available to shareholders.

lxc_7e5721891aa57bd4.text: If the business becomes weak, heavy debt can make its problems worse.

lxc_ae9fd5d55b4619f4.text: Risk is the possibility that an investment loses value.

lxc_d97698c3265b1823.text: Share prices can fall because profit falls, debt rises, competition grows, or the economy weakens.

lxc_bdcb0d1ef585e9d0.text: Toyota depends partly on demand for vehicles and the cost of making them.

lxc_23cfdc2d97533c10.text: ASML depends partly on chipmakers ordering its machines.

lxc_b634e23c8f762a6b.text: A real company can be strong today and still face future risk.

lxc_374590fe23f3141f.text: Some companies share part of their profits directly with shareholders.

lxc_4ca95ea8ec38a552.text: The payment schedule differs by company, and a company may raise, reduce, or stop its dividend.

lxc_06ee45ac196555dc.text: A dividend is normally calculated per share, so an owner with more shares receives more money.

lxc_0250f3a338c193f4.text: Microsoft reports both dividend payments and continued investment in its business.

lxc_01f7313231f23ad7.text: Other companies may keep more profit to build factories, develop products, or repay debt.

lxc_94d97156b8e4004a.text: A dividend can provide cash even when a share price does not rise, but it does not make a stock safe: the share price can still fall by more than the dividend paid.

lxc_2d0e1cfe20cbfb17.text: The difference between an individual stock and an index fund is concentration.

lxc_21e2c290e14947d5.text: An individual stock gives you ownership in one company.

lxc_a6a383933da0c88e.text: If that company does poorly, your investment can fall sharply.

lxc_7003b1a953143c0b.text: An index fund holds shares in many companies at once, so your money is spread across the companies it tracks.

lxc_fa131c313c36247b.text: The S&P 500 covers 500 large U.S. companies, including Microsoft, and State Street's SPY ETF aims to follow that index before expenses.

lxc_dca7ed030026d430.text: A TOPIX index fund follows a market-capitalization-weighted benchmark covering an extensive part of the Japanese stock market, including Toyota.

lxc_9f3aaef8ca4bd7b1.text: A STOXX Europe 600 index fund follows 600 large, mid-sized, and small companies from 17 European countries, including ASML.

lxc_a084b712097b32c3.text: Each regional index fund spreads company-specific risk, but it can still fall when its whole market falls.

lxc_d6278ce0f29e9365.text: Diversification means spreading investments across different companies, industries, and countries to reduce risk.

lxc_7a866fe2f07a5203.text: If a portfolio contains only car companies and the car industry struggles, its investments may fall together.

lxc_c53b4d1fc2f98714.text: If it also holds technology, healthcare, and companies from different countries, a fall in one area may have less effect on the whole portfolio.

lxc_f7bc77935dd3b38d.text: For example, Toyota operates in Japan's automotive industry, ASML is a Dutch maker of semiconductor equipment, and Microsoft is a U.S. software and cloud company.

lxc_f3ca76868e821fb1.text: Holding these three stocks is more diversified than holding only one, but three stocks are still a small portfolio.

lxc_9360f6cd4255e10f.text: A broad index fund can hold hundreds of companies.

lxc_3d3f1c134b99d2da.text: Diversification does not remove all risk.

lxc_5606f83ad5b964f9.text: Many markets can fall at the same time, and a fund focused on one region is not the same as a global fund.

lxc_ef1de0be6f8882ba.text: Diversification mainly reduces the damage that one company or one industry can cause.
